exit 0
--- stdout
Review a bounded correction without retiring a merged plan's provider identity
Usage:
liza amend-plan <original-id> (--reason <text> | --apply <correction-id> | --replace-pending <correction-id> --reason <text> | --withdraw-pending <correction-id> --reason <text>) [flags]
Flags:
--agent-id string Orchestrator identity
--apply string Adopt the exact independently reviewed MERGED pending correction
--changed-by string identifier for audit trail (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var, defaults to 'human')
--contract Review CONTRACT prose in referenced architecture Scopes with the complete output manifest unchanged, including expanded originals
-h, --help help for amend-plan
--json output result as structured JSON
--reason string Reason for the bounded reviewed correction
--replace-pending string Replace an unapplied MERGED or canceled pending correction
--trigger string Explicit correction trigger for daily planning metrics
--withdraw-pending string Operator: release the fence of a canceled pending correction when nothing since the last applied correction reached integration
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
